messages:
Ethan L.: FYI I noticed a cluster of DAST jobs failing with KMS:Decrypt errors after yesterday's RBAC/terraform apply. Also several SAST runs reported "ownerless file" for modules we know have CODEOWNERS.

Ethan L.: sample log:
```
2024-08-15T22:12:01Z dast-run: unwrap error: KMS:DecryptDenied key projects/redwood-inference/locations/global/keyRings/artifact-keys/cryptoKeys/encrypt-1
2024-08-15T22:12:02Z sast: ownership-check: repo read: 403 Forbidden
```

Priya R.: Which binding got changed? I only removed a stale group from a couple projects but I didn't touch the scanner SA intentionally. Could be terraform drift.

Infra-Eng: We ran a drift fix overnight that removed roles/logging.viewer from the audit-sink service account when consolidating sinks. That SA is used by the scanner to fetch logs for ownership verification; without it the audit export shows a hole.

sec-oncall: Important: missing audit logs + KMS denies are two separate failure modes but might be correlated via a role change that also removed KMS grants. Check IAM audit entries for the apply time and list policy delta.

Ethan L.: I pulled the Cloud Audit logs. There's a quiet period between 2024-08-15T22:11:58Z and 22:15:10Z where we have no scanner requests recorded. The scanner's requests before/after have requestIDs: rq-9f3a, rq-9f3b.

audit-bot: exported logs for window 2024-08-15T22:10:00Z-2024-08-15T22:20:00Z saved to gs://sec-exports/incident-1729999999/ (partial, gap present)

Priya R.: Quick mitigation I re-applied a permissive grant to the scanner-SA: roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter and roles/source.reader for the monorepo. Command used:
```bash
gcloud projects add-iam-policy-binding redwood-inference \
  --member=serviceAccount:scanner-sa@redwood-inference.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```

Infra-Eng: Re-applied log-sink viewer role to audit-sink-sa and re-enabled the sink. Also confirmed terraform state was updated to avoid drift.

qa-lead: Re-run of pipelines shows most DASTs pass; SAST still flags ~12 PRs as ownerless because the ownership-service returned 403 during blame calls. The ownership cache TTL seems to have kept the bad state for ~10 mins.

Ethan L.: Proposed short-term pipeline change: if ownership service returns non-2xx, fallback to in-repo CODEOWNERS inference and mark the result as "owner-inferred" rather than hard-failing PR checks. Create follow-up to tighten policies after investigation.

sec-oncall: Agreed. Also open a cloud support case for the audit-log gap (include requestIDs rq-9f3a/rq-9f3b, sink name, and time window). If logs were exported, ask for assistance in reconstructing events.

security-manager: Please include a blameless timeline and whether the RBAC change was approved via change control. If terraform auto-remediations caused drift, we need a rollout checklist before bulk applies (pre-check IAM bindings for service accounts used by critical pipelines).

Priya R.: Filing tickets: T-1001 rehydrate-scanner-iam (assign Infra-Eng), T-1002 owner-fallback-pipeline (assign Ethan), T-1003 audit-support-case (assign sec-oncall). I'll attach the gcloud commands and terraform plan snippet to T-1001.

Ethan L.: I'll land owner-fallback PR today with feature flag: owner-service.fallback=true. Also adding metrics alert: ownership-service error-rate > 1% triggers P0.

Infra-Eng: Follow-up actions: 1) add pre-rotation/terraform-apply checklist that verifies service account grants 2) add boxed integration test that simulates KMS-rotation and validates scanner decrypt path 3) schedule runbook update for audit-sink handling.

sec-oncall: If cloud support cannot recover the missing logs, consider extending retention on adjacent sinks and enable more verbose request id propagation in scanner. Also audit who can apply IAM changes to projects with critical pipelines.

qa-lead: Will coordinate with payments and billing teams: ping me when all SASTs are green and I'll mark affected PRs for re-run.

security-manager: Thanks everyone. Please keep updates in the tickets and add links here when available. :thumbsup:
